sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A perennial carnivorous plant of the Guiana Highlands in northern Venezuela and Guyana. It grows on wet tepuis and rocks at about 1,200–2,100 m.

sections.title: Pitchers and flowers
sections.text: The upright tubular pitchers are usually 25–45 cm long and hairless in their upper third. The flowers have tepals about 3–5 cm long. Some databases treat the species as H. heterodoxa var. glabra.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is documented; this carnivorous plant is not a food plant.
